text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A kingdom... Easier said than done,
and by degrees, I find myself losing sight of what it truly means...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: For whose sake, truly—does a kingdom exist?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The clan, or the people of the realm?
Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Should it exist for the sake of a far wider audience, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My rosy dream begins to fade...
This is entirely due to...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is due to my own hesitation.
Ah, where might the answer lie...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having entered a period of deep contemplation,
Rose Kingdom began showing up late quite often after that...
